title: Perampanel

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: Perampanel (also known as Fycompa) is a synthetic non-competitive antagonist of the AMPA receptor, belonging to the class of dissociatives and categorized as an anticonvulsant.
